focus_area_title: Listen to and Act on Ideas
content_text_body:
People feel appreciated and included when their leaders listen to and act on their ideas. The goal is to be fully present when listening so that you can evaluate and implement your team's good ideas.

[Appreciate input and suggestions from all](video "LiL3_Input_from_All")

**Watch**: *Appreciate input and suggestions from all*

---

### Listening tips for leaders

Show your team members respect by acknowledging their unique experiences and honoring their individual points of view. Doing this with sincerity demonstrates that you genuinely care about them as people.

Practice these [Listening Tips](Glint_Leadership_Tips_for_Being_a_Better_Listener) to become a better listener and leader.

### Act on good ideas

When team members come to you with good ideas, encourage them to think critically about those ideas to evaluate their potential. Help them brainstorm ways to implement these ideas at your company, encouraging them to take the lead.
